title: The Teasers
writer: Francesco Milizia, Marino Onorati, Michele Massimo Tarantini
actors: Gloria Guida, Giuseppe Pambieri, Gianfranco D'Angelo
plot: Loredana, a schoolgirl, exploits her innocence, seducing students and teachers. After losing virginity to an older man, she discovers life's deeper meanings beyond mere seduction.
